# Toolskyt

> Free online tools that run entirely in your browser: finance calculators, PDF and image tools, developer utilities, converters and more. No sign-up, no uploads, no tracking.

- [All tools](https://toolskyt.com/all-tools): full A–Z directory

## Finance

- [EMI Calculator](https://toolskyt.com/finance/emi-calculator): Calculate your monthly loan EMI with amortization schedule
- [Home Loan Calculator](https://toolskyt.com/finance/home-loan-calculator): Calculate home loan EMI, interest & total repayment amount
- [Car Loan Calculator](https://toolskyt.com/finance/car-loan-calculator): Calculate car loan EMI and total cost of vehicle financing
- [Personal Loan Calculator](https://toolskyt.com/finance/personal-loan-calculator): Calculate personal loan EMI for unsecured credit
- [Education Loan Calculator](https://toolskyt.com/finance/education-loan-calculator): Calculate student loan EMI with moratorium period
- [Loan Eligibility Calculator](https://toolskyt.com/finance/loan-eligibility-calculator): Check your maximum loan eligibility based on income
- [SIP Calculator](https://toolskyt.com/finance/sip-calculator): Calculate SIP returns for systematic investment plans
- [FD Calculator](https://toolskyt.com/finance/fd-calculator): Calculate fixed deposit maturity amount and interest earned
- [RD Calculator](https://toolskyt.com/finance/rd-calculator): Calculate recurring deposit maturity amount
- [PPF Calculator](https://toolskyt.com/finance/ppf-calculator): Calculate Public Provident Fund maturity with year-wise breakdown
- [EPF Calculator](https://toolskyt.com/finance/epf-calculator): Calculate Employee Provident Fund corpus and returns
- [Retirement Calculator](https://toolskyt.com/finance/retirement-calculator): Plan your retirement corpus and monthly income needs
- [GST Calculator](https://toolskyt.com/finance/gst-calculator): Calculate GST amount for goods and services instantly
- [Income Tax Calculator](https://toolskyt.com/finance/income-tax-calculator): Calculate income tax under old and new tax regime for FY 2024-25
- [Salary Calculator](https://toolskyt.com/finance/salary-calculator): Calculate take-home salary from CTC with all deductions
- [HRA Calculator](https://toolskyt.com/finance/hra-calculator): Calculate HRA exemption under Section 10(13A)
- [Compound Interest Calculator](https://toolskyt.com/finance/compound-interest-calculator): Calculate compound interest with different compounding frequencies
- [Simple Interest Calculator](https://toolskyt.com/finance/simple-interest-calculator): Calculate simple interest on principal amount
- [Currency Converter](https://toolskyt.com/finance/currency-converter): Convert between 170+ world currencies with live rates
- [Inflation Calculator](https://toolskyt.com/finance/inflation-calculator): Calculate the future value of money adjusted for inflation
- [Budget Planner](https://toolskyt.com/finance/budget-planner): Create a monthly budget and track income vs expenses
- [Gratuity Calculator](https://toolskyt.com/finance/gratuity-calculator): Calculate gratuity amount under Payment of Gratuity Act
- [Stock Average Calculator](https://toolskyt.com/finance/stock-average-calculator): Calculate average purchase price of stocks across multiple buys
- [Brokerage Calculator](https://toolskyt.com/finance/brokerage-calculator): Calculate brokerage fees, STT, and other charges for stock trading
- [Tip Calculator](https://toolskyt.com/finance/tip-calculator): Calculate tip amount and split the bill among friends
- [Bill Splitter](https://toolskyt.com/finance/bill-splitter): Split bills among multiple people with custom shares
- [Expense Tracker](https://toolskyt.com/finance/expense-tracker): Track daily expenses and view spending by category
- [Savings Planner](https://toolskyt.com/finance/savings-planner): Plan and track your savings goals with timeline
- [Net Worth Calculator](https://toolskyt.com/finance/net-worth-calculator): Calculate your total net worth from assets and liabilities
- [Gold Investment Calculator](https://toolskyt.com/finance/gold-investment-calculator): Calculate gold investment returns and compare with other assets
- [Crypto Profit Calculator](https://toolskyt.com/finance/crypto-profit-calculator): Calculate cryptocurrency profit/loss and tax implications
- [Subscription Tracker](https://toolskyt.com/finance/subscription-tracker): Track all your recurring subscriptions and monthly costs
- [Credit Card EMI Calculator](https://toolskyt.com/finance/credit-card-emi): Calculate credit card EMI and compare with paying full amount
- [Mutual Fund Calculator](https://toolskyt.com/finance/mutual-fund-calculator): Calculate mutual fund returns for lump sum investments
- [Loan Comparison Tool](https://toolskyt.com/finance/loan-comparison): Compare multiple loan offers side-by-side
- [Lumpsum Calculator](https://toolskyt.com/finance/lumpsum-calculator): Estimate the future value of a one-time investment with yearly growth chart
- [SWP Calculator](https://toolskyt.com/finance/swp-calculator): Plan a Systematic Withdrawal Plan — see how long your corpus lasts
- [CAGR Calculator](https://toolskyt.com/finance/cagr-calculator): Compute compound annual growth rate between two values

## Developer

- [JSON Formatter & Validator](https://toolskyt.com/developer/json-formatter): Format, validate, and beautify JSON with syntax highlighting
- [Base64 Encoder / Decoder](https://toolskyt.com/developer/base64): Encode and decode Base64 strings and files
- [URL Encoder / Decoder](https://toolskyt.com/developer/url-encoder): Encode and decode URLs and query parameters
- [JWT Decoder & Inspector](https://toolskyt.com/developer/jwt-decoder): Decode and inspect JWT tokens with claims validation
- [UUID Generator](https://toolskyt.com/developer/uuid-generator): Generate UUIDs (v1, v4, v5) individually or in bulk
- [Hash Generator](https://toolskyt.com/developer/hash-generator): Generate MD5, SHA-1, SHA-256, SHA-512 hashes
- [Regex Tester](https://toolskyt.com/developer/regex-tester): Test and debug regular expressions with real-time match highlighting
- [Timestamp Converter](https://toolskyt.com/developer/timestamp-converter): Convert between Unix timestamps and human-readable dates
- [Alternative Timestamps Converter](https://toolskyt.com/developer/alternative-timestamps): Convert between LDAP, Chrome, NTP, Cocoa, GPS, and Unix epoch timestamps
- [Color Picker & Converter](https://toolskyt.com/developer/color-picker): Pick colors and convert between HEX, RGB, HSL, HSV formats
- [SQL Formatter](https://toolskyt.com/developer/sql-formatter): Format and beautify SQL queries with keyword highlighting
- [Diff Checker](https://toolskyt.com/developer/diff-checker): Compare two texts or code blocks side-by-side
- [Password Generator](https://toolskyt.com/developer/password-generator): Generate strong, secure passwords with custom rules
- [Lorem Ipsum Generator](https://toolskyt.com/developer/lorem-ipsum): Generate Lorem Ipsum placeholder text of any length
- [Gradient Generator](https://toolskyt.com/developer/gradient-generator): Create CSS gradients visually and copy the CSS code
- [Cron Expression Builder](https://toolskyt.com/developer/cron-builder): Build and validate cron expressions with human-readable descriptions
- [Markdown Preview](https://toolskyt.com/developer/markdown-preview): Write and preview Markdown with live rendering
- [HTML Entity Encoder/Decoder](https://toolskyt.com/developer/html-entity-encoder): Escape or unescape HTML entities safely in your browser
- [JSON ⇄ CSV Converter](https://toolskyt.com/developer/json-csv-converter): Convert JSON arrays to CSV and CSV back to JSON, with nested-key flattening
- [Chmod Calculator](https://toolskyt.com/developer/chmod-calculator): Build Unix file permissions visually — octal, symbolic and command output
- [URL Parser](https://toolskyt.com/developer/url-parser): Break a URL into protocol, host, path, query params and hash

## PDF Tools

- [HTML to PDF Converter](https://toolskyt.com/pdf/html-to-pdf): Convert HTML and CSS code to a downloadable PDF document
- [Image to PDF Converter](https://toolskyt.com/pdf/image-to-pdf): Convert JPG, PNG, and WebP images to a single PDF document
- [Markdown to PDF Converter](https://toolskyt.com/pdf/markdown-to-pdf): Convert Markdown documents into clean, styled PDF reports
- [PDF Metadata & Compression](https://toolskyt.com/pdf/pdf-metadata): View and edit PDF document metadata properties client-side
- [Merge PDF](https://toolskyt.com/pdf/merge): Combine multiple PDF files into one — reorder before merging
- [Split & Extract PDF Pages](https://toolskyt.com/pdf/split): Extract page ranges or split a PDF into separate files
- [Rotate PDF Pages](https://toolskyt.com/pdf/rotate): Rotate all or selected PDF pages by 90°, 180° or 270°

## Image Tools

- [Image Resizer](https://toolskyt.com/image/resize): Resize images to any dimension while maintaining aspect ratio
- [Image Compressor](https://toolskyt.com/image/compress): Compress images and reduce file size without quality loss
- [Image Cropper](https://toolskyt.com/image/crop): Crop images to custom dimensions or preset aspect ratios
- [QR Code Generator](https://toolskyt.com/image/qr-generator): Generate QR codes for URLs, text, contact, WiFi and more
- [Barcode Generator](https://toolskyt.com/image/barcode-generator): Generate barcodes in various formats (EAN, UPC, CODE128)
- [Image to JPG Converter](https://toolskyt.com/image/jpg-converter): Convert PNG, WEBP, GIF images to JPG format
- [Image to WEBP Converter](https://toolskyt.com/image/webp-converter): Convert images to WEBP format for web optimization
- [Color Palette Extractor](https://toolskyt.com/image/color-palette): Extract dominant colors from any image
- [Favicon Generator](https://toolskyt.com/image/favicon-generator): Generate favicon.ico and all required sizes from any image
- [Image to Base64](https://toolskyt.com/image/image-to-base64): Turn an image into a Base64 data URI, CSS or HTML snippet
- [Rotate & Flip Image](https://toolskyt.com/image/rotate-flip): Rotate by 90° steps or any angle and flip horizontally or vertically
- [Image Filters](https://toolskyt.com/image/image-filters): Brightness, contrast, grayscale, sepia, blur and more — live preview

- [Emoji Search & Copy](https://toolskyt.com/text/emoji-search): Search, browse, and copy emojis with skin tone support
- [PDF to Markdown](https://toolskyt.com/text/pdf-to-markdown): Convert PDF document text to clean Markdown formatting
- [Numbers to Words Converter](https://toolskyt.com/text/numbers-to-words): Convert numbers to English words and Chinese characters
- [Detect Language](https://toolskyt.com/text/detect-language): Identify the language of any text block instantly
- [Remove Spaces & Clean Text](https://toolskyt.com/text/remove-spaces): Remove double spaces, tabs, and excess line breaks
- [Read Math Expressions](https://toolskyt.com/text/read-math-expressions): Convert mathematical equations into English words
- [Multilingual Date Converter](https://toolskyt.com/text/date-converter): Convert and format dates across calendars and languages
- [Sort & Dedupe Lines](https://toolskyt.com/text/text-sorter): Sort, reverse, shuffle and remove duplicate lines instantly
- [Find & Replace](https://toolskyt.com/text/find-replace): Bulk find and replace with regex, case and whole-word options
- [Readability Checker](https://toolskyt.com/text/readability-checker): Flesch reading ease, grade level and Gunning Fog score for any text

## Converters

- [Length Converter](https://toolskyt.com/convert/length): Convert between meters, feet, inches, miles, km and all length units
- [Weight Converter](https://toolskyt.com/convert/weight): Convert between kg, pounds, grams, ounces, tons
- [Temperature Converter](https://toolskyt.com/convert/temperature): Convert between Celsius, Fahrenheit, and Kelvin
- [Data Storage Converter](https://toolskyt.com/convert/data-storage): Convert between bytes, KB, MB, GB, TB
- [Area Converter](https://toolskyt.com/convert/area): Convert between m², hectares, acres, sq ft, sq yd and more
- [Volume Converter](https://toolskyt.com/convert/volume): Convert litres, millilitres, gallons, cups, tablespoons and cubic units
- [Speed Converter](https://toolskyt.com/convert/speed): Convert km/h, mph, m/s, knots and Mach
- [Time Converter](https://toolskyt.com/convert/time): Convert seconds, minutes, hours, days, weeks, months and years
- [Number Base Converter](https://toolskyt.com/convert/number-base): Binary, octal, decimal, hex and any base up to 36 — arbitrary precision
- [Roman Numeral Converter](https://toolskyt.com/convert/roman-numerals): Convert numbers to Roman numerals and back (1–3999)
